caption: The video captures a fixed view of a shallow puddle resting on dark asphalt beside a rough concrete curb, its surface mirroring a pale sky and shadowy building forms. An already-in-progress set of concentric ripples occupies the center-left of the water, the rings widening outward and gradually softening over the following moments. Near the center-right, a small splash crown briefly bulges above the surface before collapsing back down. From this point a second, separate set of circular ripples emerges, distinct from the fading first pattern. These new rings expand steadily outward. The curb and grass remain fixed, while reflected sky and building forms are disturbed by the ripples, and the two patterns overlap in time at different centers.
